text: Olloudios is a Continental Celtic and British god. He is a seldom-named Gaulish god who may have served as a local genius loci, with worship given in a tree. His name may join roots that signify a huge tree. His chief region lay on the islands off southern France, the Antibes. There the tribe of the Narbonenses honored him. He also reached Britain, where Gloucester showed him with huge ears that stuck out like wings.

okr.objective: Olloudios is an obscure Gaulish god tied to great trees.
